finding: Spec requires a bearer token everywhere, but the Prism mock accepts any token so real JWT checks cannot be tested on the mock. Real checks (signature, expiry <= 1 h) live in the API.
mitigation: Reject tokens with algorithm none. Set token lifetime to 1 hour or less in Entra External ID. Keep only /health public.

finding: GET /books/{bookId}/loans has no ownership check and no 403 response. Member 5 sends GET /books/42/loans; book 42 belongs to member 3 and the API returns member 3's borrower history. IDs are plain numbers so they are easy to guess.
mitigation: Add ownership check in the SQL query: WHERE b.id = @bookId AND b.owner_id = @callerId. Return 404 if no row. Apply the same rule to the other {id} endpoints. Add a 403 response to the spec.

finding: GET /books takes free text in the search parameter. If the code joins it into a SQL LIKE string an attacker can run their own SQL.
mitigation: Always use parameterised queries. Never join user text into SQL.

finding: Azure SQL connection string, Redis password and Blob Storage keys stored in .env and committed to GitHub.
mitigation: Store SQL, Redis and Service Bus secrets in Azure Key Vault. App Service reads them with a managed identity (Key Vault references). Rotate every 3 months. Add .env to .gitignore.

finding: Front Door must only allow HTTPS. Attackers could call the App Service URL directly and skip the WAF and rate limits.
mitigation: On App Service turn on HTTPS only and add an access restriction that allows only the Front Door service tag.

finding: No rate limit yet on sensitive endpoints: borrow requests (spam), book creation (fake listings), photo upload (5 MB uploads) and repeated login failures.
mitigation: Add an Azure Front Door WAF rate-limit rule: 20 requests per minute per IP on POST endpoints and 5 failed auth attempts per minute per IP. Return 429 with Retry-After. Add 429 to the OpenAPI spec.

finding: Responses are clean (no address or phone in schemas) but logs and queues can leak: Authorization header or request body in App Insights, search text in URLs, member names in Notification.message, emails in Service Bus digest messages.
endpoint: GET /notifications; App Insights logs; Service Bus digest queue
mitigation: Add an App Insights telemetry processor that removes the Authorization header, request bodies and the search value. Log only member ID and request ID. Put member IDs in Service Bus messages and look up emails inside the worker.
